04 / HOW IT FITS TOGETHER

Know what you’re looking at.

OBSERVED

The physical world

Street geometry, building names and addresses, and the Bay coastline come from OpenStreetMap. The city overview uses San Francisco neighborhood boundaries.

OpenStreetMap ↗San Francisco boundaries ↗
ESTIMATED

The housing context

Rent, income, population and housing counts come from saved Census ACS five-year releases. Margins of error are shown where available. City medians are not property prices.

Download Census dataset ↓
SIMULATED

The lived experience

Prices, unit sizes, rents, HOA costs, residents and household budgets are illustrative. AI gives fictional residents a voice; Cala retrieves separate neighborhood research with source links.

Artwork represents mapped locations, not exact building appearances. No real residents are being surveyed.
